rows.definition: Planner's chosen resident view: selected set, elided set, and accounting
rows.distinction: Planner's resident view selection - NOT Plan (memq) (static explain output)

rows.definition: Static pre-execution Explain output: pipeline steps, effects, and mutations
rows.distinction: Static pre-execution explain output - NOT Plan (planner) (resident view)

rows.definition: Scored span the planner may keep resident with cost, benefit, and density metrics
rows.distinction: Scored span input to planner - NOT Plan (planner's output)

rows.definition: The deterministic candidate archive the Strix validation path stages for hardware: the repo's base git tip plus exactly the owned paths, packaged with the tarball bytes and their source SHA-256, built by BuildStrixCandidateArchive.
rows.distinction: The staged validation candidate SOURCE ARCHIVE (base tip + owned paths, digest-bound) - NOT Candidate (a scored planner span) and NOT the per-loop CandidatesExamined/candidateTokens counters.

rows.definition: The goalrunner launch option `PlanOnly` (`plan_only`) that resolves the account, runs the shift-left preflight, formats and writes the prompt plus a plan-only receipt, then returns WITHOUT spawning a worker.
rows.distinction: The DRY-RUN launch mode that spawns nothing - NOT the executed dispatch plan `LaunchPlan` (pricing's wave-grouped targets) and NOT the campaign `WavePlan` (debtlane's ordered waves).

rows.definition: The canonical schema identifier constant `WavePlanSchema` (`internal/debtlane/wave.go`, `"fak.debt-orchestrator-wave-plan.v1"`) stamped onto every concurrent-safe wave plan so a consumer can verify the wire format of a plan it reads back.
rows.distinction: The wire-format VERSION ID stamped on a plan - NOT the campaign plan data itself (`WavePlan`) and NOT the per-wave execution plan (`dispatchWaveExecutionPlan`).

rows.definition: Package-level function VALUE bound to amdgpu.BuildStrixCandidateArchive in each validating package (internal/validate, internal/devcmd, cmd/fak); it is the test seam a probing harness swaps to replace the archive builder without touching the real builder.
rows.distinction: The swappable builder INDIRECTION (a package var holding a func value) - NOT the deterministic archive it produces (StrixCandidateArchive) and NOT candidate-planner's scored planner span.

rows.definition: The complete enforced resident footprint for a native serve - weights + aggregate per-session KV/recurrent state for the enforced simultaneous-session bound + per-cohort scratch - preserved with class breakdown so admission can refuse before a loader when weights fit but the full enrolled state envelope does not.
rows.distinction: A classed MEMORY-BUDGET envelope for admission (weights + MaxSessions * per-session state + cohort scratch) - NOT the planner's chosen resident view (Plan (planner)) and NOT memq's static pre-execution explain output (Plan (memq)).

rows.definition: The adaptive-discovery accounting block riding on an issueorchestrator campaign plan: scanned candidates, discovery-window size, window expansions, unplannable ratio, and advisory warnings about how the plan widened its horizon.
rows.distinction: The issueorchestrator campaign plan's discovery ACCOUNTING (how the plan window expanded) - NOT Plan (planner)'s chosen resident view, NOT Plan (memq)'s static pre-execution explain output, and NOT internal/compute's MatMulPlan.Diagnostics preparation/break-even run timings.

rows.definition: readmenext's staged README-front-page change unit: one target section plus the candidate_content text, its retire_target, its witness provenance, and the laws checklist, carried from proposal to publication.
rows.distinction: readmenext's staged README change FRAGMENT - NOT Candidate (the planner's scored resident span) and NOT the StrixCandidateArchive (the deterministic hardware-validation source archive).
